description: This file defines configuration constants for unit testing patterns related to a codebase, including include and exclude patterns for different test categories and boundaries. It also contains utility functions to determine if a file matches certain test categories based on its path.

methods.name: isUnitConfigTestFile
methods.description: Determines if a given file path matches the patterns for unit configuration test files, considering include patterns and excluding certain directories.

methods.name: isBundledPluginDependentUnitTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is part of the bundled plugin dependent unit test files list.

methods.name: isBoundaryTestFile
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is part of the boundary test files list.
